differences: The paper could not be read when this release was made (publisher access refused), so no number from the paper was reproduced: the published checks are facts documented in the deposit's own readme (column layout and sampling grid). The paper's participant and trial counts and pursuit results are not rebuilt here.

The readme says all data are coded so that target 2 moved to the lower right, but horizontal_target_direction_2 is 1 (rightward) only in the value manipulation; in the salience manipulation it takes both values -1 and 1 (and vertical_target_direction_2 takes both values in every file), so the coding statement is not true of every row; values are left as saved.
The deposit has no exclusion flags; excluded_by_authors is False in every row.
